verses.text: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.
Then the LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put sinful stumbling blocks in front of their faces. Should I let them ask me for advice at all?

So speak to them and tell them, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: When any of the people of Israel set up idols in their hearts and put a sinful stumbling block in front of their faces, and then come to a prophet, I the LORD will answer them myself, as their many idols deserve.
I will do this to win back the hearts of the people of Israel, who have all turned away from me to follow their idols.'
So tell the people of Israel, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Turn back! Turn away from your idols! Turn your faces away from all your disgusting practices!

When any of the people of Israel, or any foreigner living in Israel, turns away from me, sets up idols in their heart, and puts a sinful stumbling block in front of their face, and then comes to a prophet to ask me for advice, I the LORD will answer them myself.
I will turn my face against that person and make them a warning and an example to others. I will cut them off from my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
And if the prophet is deceived into giving a message, it is I, the LORD, who allowed that prophet to be deceived. I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from among my people Israel.
They will both be punished for their sin. The prophet will be just as guilty as the one who came to him.
Then the people of Israel will no longer wander away from me or make themselves unclean with all their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God, says the Lord GOD.'"
The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, suppose a country sins against me by being unfaithful, and I stretch out my hand against it. I cut off its food supply, send famine on it, and wipe out both people and animals.
Even if these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were living there, their righteousness would save only themselves," says the Lord GOD.
"Or suppose I send wild animals through that country, and they leave it without children and so desolate that no one can travel through it because of the animals.

As surely as I live," says the Lord GOD, "even if these three men were living there, they could not save their own sons or daughters. Only they themselves would be saved, and the land would become a wasteland.
Or suppose I bring a sword against that country and say, 'Let the sword sweep through the land,' and I wipe out both people and animals.
As surely as I live," says the Lord GOD, "even if these three men were living there, they could not save their own sons or daughters. Only they themselves would be saved.
Or suppose I send a disease into that country and pour out my fury on it through bloodshed, wiping out both people and animals.
As surely as I live," says the Lord GOD, "even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living there, they could not save their own son or daughter. Their righteousness would save only themselves."
For this is what the Lord GOD says: "How much worse it will be when I send my four terrible punishments against Jerusalem: war, famine, wild animals, and disease, to wipe out both people and animals!

But look, some survivors will be left, sons and daughters who will be brought out of it. They will come to you, and when you see how they live and what they do, you will be comforted about the disaster I brought on Jerusalem, about everything I brought on it.
You will be comforted when you see how they live and what they do. Then you will know that I did not do anything there without good reason," says the Lord GOD.
